# awscc_cognito_user_pool_session_configuration_attachment (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Cognito::UserPoolSessionConfigurationAttachment. Manages the session configuration of a user pool: whether user session tracking is enabled and the maximum number of concurrent token sessions per user. The service default (UserSessionTracking DISABLED with TokenSession MaxPerUser 20) cannot be declared; remove the resource to return the user pool to the default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `token_session` (Attributes) Token session settings that apply to every app client in the user pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_session))
- `user_pool_id` (String) The ID of the user pool.
- `user_session_tracking` (String) Whether server-side user session tracking is enabled for the user pool. Requires the ESSENTIALS or PLUS feature plan.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--token_session"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_session`

Required:

- `max_per_user` (Number) The maximum number of concurrent token sessions per user across all app clients. When a new session would exceed this number, the least recently used session ends.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cognito_user_pool_session_configuration_attachment.example
  identity = {
    user_pool_id = "user_pool_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `user_pool_id` (String) The ID of the user pool

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cognito_user_pool_session_configuration_attachment.example
  id = "user_pool_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_cognito_user_pool_session_configuration_attachment.example "user_pool_id"
```
